description: Turn the business's number into a hosted phone system: Kai is installed as extension 700, the owner's mobile joins the list of phones to ring first, and calls reach Kai when nobody picks up. Idempotent and resumable — a re-run reuses everything already created and reports it under `reused`. Needs a complete US street address on file (the emergency-services and tax location) and the owner's mobile: when either is missing the tool fails with `code` missing_address or missing_owner_mobile plus `required_field` and `next_action` naming exactly what is missing, which business_address or owner_mobile accepts. Returns the status shape (existing setup IDs, extension and the phone-system line) and `next_step`, the owner's next action in one line (forward your line here / dial 700 from any office phone). Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-system action=provision.

business_address.description: The business street address to save before provisioning. Optional when a complete address is already on file; required when the last attempt returned missing_address.

business_id.description: Business ID (required when the token can access multiple businesses).

owner_mobile.description: The owner's own mobile number (US). Optional when set_owner_phone already saved one; required when the last attempt returned missing_owner_mobile.

persona.description: Which phones the business runs on, if the owner said: cell_only (just the owner's cell) or office (desk phones / an existing office line that will forward in). Shapes next_step; optional.

name: set_up_phone_system

issues.description: Address fields to correct when code is invalid_address.

line.description: The phone-system line (E.164), if a number is attached.

next_action.description: What to collect and how to retry, when blocked.

next_step.description: The one line to relay to the owner.

required_field.description: Present when setup is blocked on a missing input.

title: Set Up Phone System
